$comment: Static reference values for /what-if. Lacks a clean live API — update annually as the source publications drop new editions. Served as a static asset so a JSON-only commit redeploys without touching the app bundle.

offshoreWealth.source: BCG Global Wealth Report 2025 — cross-border private wealth (end-2024)

globalEconomy.source: IMF World Economic Outlook April 2026 — nominal global GDP (2026 projection)

goldSupply.source: World Gold Council — all-time mined gold

goldPriceFallbackUsd.source: Recent gold spot range — used only when /api/ticker is unreachable
